purpose: Named accountable owner and operational steward for each critical asset.
evidence: Approved owner/steward assignments; review date; open issue log.

purpose: Classify data and approve access based on role, purpose and least privilege.
evidence: Classification; access approval; periodic recertification; access log.

purpose: Critical elements have measurable rules, thresholds, issue owners and remediation evidence.
evidence: Rule results; issue ticket; root cause; accepted disposition.

purpose: Critical data is discoverable, defined, sourced and traced across material transformations.
evidence: Catalogue record; approved definition; lineage; change record.

control_name: Purpose, lawful basis and privacy assessment
purpose: Personal-data processing purpose, lawful basis, transparency, minimisation, retention and DPIA screening are assessed before use.
evidence: Processing record; privacy assessment; DPIA decision; notices; retention rule.

purpose: AI use cases are inventoried, scoped, risk assessed and routed to proportionate review before development or procurement.
evidence: Use-case record; risk decision; committee outcome.

purpose: Appropriate independent challenge, testing, approval and version control precede deployment and material changes.
evidence: Validation report; approval; release record; rollback plan.

purpose: Monitor performance, data drift, outcomes, overrides, complaints, security and supplier notices with escalation thresholds.
evidence: Monitoring pack; alerts; incident log; action closure.

purpose: Assess supplier, data rights, security, resilience, model changes, subcontractors and exit/continuity arrangements.
evidence: Due diligence; contract clauses; change notifications; exit plan.

purpose: Use relevant data and customer insight to identify poor outcomes, root causes, group differences and corrective action.
evidence: Outcome metrics; limitations; action tracker; governance review.
